title: Gazetteer - Search (all)
description: One row per UPRN for searching, including properties whose rows are all marked invalid and local records merged into another UPRN (see allInvalid and merged). Created by pg-scripts/create-view.sql.

counter.description: Counter of the chosen address row

lpiStatus.description: LPI Logical Status of the chosen row, 1: Approved, 3: Alternative, 6: Provisional, 8: Historical

dataSource.description: Where the address came from: OrdnanceSurvey (official) or a local source

otherAddressLabels.description: The property's other valid addresses, separated by '; '

allInvalid.description: Every address row is marked invalid

merged.description: A local record merged into another UPRN (active accepted match)
